problem.title: Subarrays Distinct Element Sum of Squares I

approaches.title: Enumerate subarrays and track distinct values
approaches.summary: For each starting index, extend the subarray while tracking its distinct-value count and add the count squared to the result. The second revision reuses a version-tagged array instead of reinitializing the seen array for each start.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Enumerates subarrays from each starting index using a freshly initialized array to track seen values, adding the squared distinct count for each subarray.

revisions.commitComment: i+1 denotes if it has been seen before, no need to reallocate 101 buffer
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 2913: i+1 denotes if it has been seen before, no need to reallocate 101 buffer
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Keeps the same enumeration strategy, but uses the starting index as a version tag in one reusable array to avoid reinitializing it.
